body.heading: Fold the book
paragraphs: Your adult folds a big sheet into a small booklet with eight little pages.
Number the pages lightly so your story stays in the right order.

body.heading: Fill the pages
paragraphs: Draw one part of a story on each page. A character, a problem, and a happy ending fit perfectly.
Write the words you can, and let the pictures tell the rest. Read your book aloud with pride.

takeaway: One sheet of paper can become a whole book that you made yourself.
safetyNotes: An adult helps with the folding and any trimming.
screenFreeExtension: Make a second book as a gift, and read it to the person you give it to.
